giza_geology.finding: Published plateau geology is dominated by Eocene limestone, karst and ordinary sedimentary/geomorphic history; Quaternary deposits south of the Sphinx include fluvial/alluvial quartzose sands. No credible regional Giza melt-glass horizon was found in this pass.

glass_weathering.finding: Water can hydrate and alter silicate glass through diffusion, ion exchange, hydrolysis and surface corrosion, but the reviewed literature does not support a simple direct conversion of glass into ordinary crystalline quartzose sand.

libyan_desert_glass_positive_control.finding: Libyan Desert Glass is a genuine silica-glass field in southwestern Egypt; zircon breakdown to baddeleyite plus silica glass above 1676 C is a diagnostic high-temperature signature supporting impact melting. Its geography and evidence are distinct from Giza.

orion_astrophysics.finding: Protostellar jets/outflows genuinely occur in the Orion Molecular Cloud at roughly 1300 light-years, but no credible evidence was found for an ancient Earth-directed Orion beam vitrifying Giza. Orion is a constellation/line-of-sight region, not one emitter.

pyramid_texts.finding: The Pyramid Text tradition genuinely contains royal star/transfiguration and Orion/Osiris motifs, including renewed shining in the East and the king as a great star/companion of Orion. No reviewed passage says an Orion jet vitrified Giza or created its sand.
